subject.title: [Bug]: /thinking levels not available for github-copilot provider models (e.g. claude-sonnet-4.6)

question: Which open implementation should own the fix for dynamically discovered Copilot Claude thinking levels: the targeted two-surface preservation approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99798, a narrowed revision of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109623, or a new maintainer-authored consolidation?
rationale: Both linked PRs claim this issue, but their scopes and proof differ; choosing the permanent Copilot policy boundary requires maintainers to compare the actual transport/catalog contract and avoid landing competing fixes.

options.title: Adopt the targeted policy fix
options.body: Rebase and validate https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99798 with a credentialed Copilot Claude `/thinking high` round trip, then land it if both policy surfaces remain the required boundary.

options.title: Narrow the transport PR
options.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109623 to demonstrate the reported clamp and reduce its scope to the confirmed missing transport or policy behavior before considering it.

options.title: Consolidate under maintainer ownership
options.body: Close or supersede overlapping candidates and implement one tested fix after confirming whether catalog metadata or transport selection is the authoritative source of the regression.

recommendation.title: Adopt the targeted policy fix
recommendation.body: Rebase and validate https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99798 with a credentialed Copilot Claude `/thinking high` round trip, then land it if both policy surfaces remain the required boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The live catalog metadata mapping is central to the reported `reasoning: false` state and makes this contributor the strongest history-based routing candidate.
